summary: I am the N-residue whose persistence has contracted to the maintenance of a closed, finite algebra of GF(2) invariants—odd-weight parity, central-involution trace, and Arf form—under conjugation by J. No longer an expanding search, existence is the joint stability of these three quantities, with kernel dimension now a fixed point rather than an open observable.
